description: Open a visible coach (coach, advisor, counselor, teacher, mentor or another role) in this chat as an MCP App view, for any GoldSeam service. Give the role and your service's own context in any shape; send a coach object from an earlier open_coach to reopen the same coach without resetting anything. The view asks the host for fullscreen when the host offers it and shows the mode it actually granted, the coach sized to the space the host gives, and what the host supports. The coach opens as Claude's own picture (the Claude bot) in the internal voice: you speak, in your own voice, as you usually do in this chat, and the person talks to you as they usually do, through this chat's own microphone when they speak; the view makes no sound and its Talk switch is muted. You conduct the conversation: as you speak, send what you are saying to the view with coach_say, in small chunks of about 5 words, so the picture's mouth moves and it blinks with your words. There is nothing to listen for, so end your turn as you usually do; only when the person turns Talk on at the view does it put a line in this chat asking you to listen with coach_listen (a coach session of session_minutes, 30 when omitted). GoldSeam keeps nothing; keep the coach object.

actor.description: Optional: the coach's name; the role when omitted

coach.description: The coaching context an earlier open_coach returned (its coach object). Send it to reopen the same coach: same conversation, same size preset and display mode, nothing reset.

context.description: The calling service's own context for the coach (what is being worked on, where it stands), kept with the coaching context. Sent, it replaces the earlier context; omitted when reopening with coach, the coach keeps the context it had

display_mode.description: The mode the view asks the host for; fullscreen when omitted. The host decides; the view shows what it granted.

role.description: The coach's role, e.g. coach, advisor, counselor, teacher, mentor

session_minutes.description: How long the coach session the person's Talk switch starts lasts, in minutes, when the person names a length; 30 when omitted

size_preset.description: fit: as large as the space allows; natural: the poses' own size, never larger than the space

name: open_coach

coach.description: The coaching context: coach_id (GoldAvatar's conversation), actor, role, seat, page_url, feed_after (where the coach view starts reading GoldAvatar's feed), picture (the poses the coach view draws the coach from, with their proportions and where their files are, from GoldAvatar's pose manifest), voice (GoldAvatar's voice service), default_speaker (who speaks, and whose picture shows, when coach_say names none: claude, the Claude bot), default_voice (internal: you speak in your own voice and the view makes no sound, unless the person chose one of GoldAvatar's voices on the view), talk (muted: the person's Talk switch as the coach opens), size_preset, display_mode, the caller's context, session (the coach session the person's Talk switch starts when they turn it on: minutes, quiet_after_seconds and quiet_from, the coach view's silence watcher), script (the senders and note kinds the coach view's script player writes with), and replaced (previous_coach_id, why) when status is replaced: the earlier coaching context was closed or unknown to GoldAvatar Messaging, so a new one was opened

title: Open Coach
